name: pragmatic-shared

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-identity && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-identity-source-local && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-identity-realm && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-identity-store && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-identity-source-oidc && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-identity-source-entra && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-identity-source-google && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-realm-adapters && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-realm-custom && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-realm-gcp && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-realm-aws && npm run build -w packages/pragmatic-realm-azure
